decisions.statement: A release is covered where its tracks run as long as the release runs.
A release that is covered takes its listening from its tracks.
A release that is not covered is left as that release is.
A release carrying no track is not covered.
A release stating no length is not covered.
A release runs as far as its tracks together run.
A release every track of which is run through is finished.
A release no track of which is run into is not started.
A release between the two is part way through.
Two lengths within a hundredth of a minute are one length.
Every release changed lands as a single commit or does not land.

definition: the command reading a release's listening off the tracks that release carries
